Aeropuerto — Madrid, Spain

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

The Aeropuerto barrio has extensive, very recent (2025) documented coverage of a severe insecurity crisis linked to the displacement of homeless people from Madrid-Barajas Airport terminals into the surrounding neighbourhood: residents have organised citizen patrols, describing themselves as 'hartos de la inseguridad, amenazas, robos' (fed up with insecurity, threats, robberies), a large building was squatted by an estimated 40+ people including former airport rough-sleepers, and residents reported people 'volviendose locos' (becoming violent) around children, the elderly and families. Airport workers separately reported insecurity moving into the terminals themselves. Sources checked: El Mundo, 17 Sept 2025 (resident mobilisation over squatted building); Facebook/Telemadrid, ~Sept 2025 (citizen patrols); Antena3, 12 Sept 2025 (40+ squatters); El Confidencial, 27 Sept 2025; Libertad Digital, 24 Sept 2025; Telemadrid, Oct 2025 (airport worker insecurity).

Frequently asked questions

Is Aeropuerto safe?

Wandroz currently rates Aeropuerto in Madrid, Spain as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Aeropuerto safe at night?

At night, Aeropuerto is rated as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Aeropuerto's day rating (roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
